The demo includes the game's opening 12 stages (full game will have 60+), which are ideal for honing your brick-breaking skills.
You can also unlock and try out two paddle enhancements: Time Warper and Laser Beam.
Also, any progress you make in the demo will be carried over to the full game when you buy it on launch day :)

notes.title: Cosmic Waves – a fresh spin on Breakout-inspired brick-breaking!
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]We're delighted to share the news that development of Cosmic Waves is nearing completion and the game will be ready for release later this year (exact date TBA)![/b][/i][/h3]

Inspired by arcade classics Breakout and Arkanoid, Cosmic Waves is a brick-breaking adventure starring two heroic wolves and their robot sidekick. A host of new features radically revamps the familiar paddle-ball-wall formula to bring greater depth, skill, and excitement to every bounce, rebound, and ricochet. 

At the core of those unique gameplay elements are energy towers, which - when triggered - emit a force wave that affects the path and power of any ball within its radius (in pinball terms, energy towers behave like a flipper and bumper combined). 

In addition to tower-powered ball manipulation, Cosmic Waves also features gadget enhanced paddles, block-blasting weaponry, action-packed levels, ability-boosting upgrades, a galaxy-spanning story, and amazing music by the super-talented Module (Shatter).

Check out the block-smashing gameplay in the brand new trailer: 

[previewyoutube=SaL8lcsfeL4;full][/previewyoutube]

The plan is to release a new demo sometime ahead of launch, so be sure to Wishlist and Follow in order to stay updated. Thanks for your support, and for joining us on this brick-breaking adventure!

[b]Matt | Digerati[/b]
